Name: Lucky Block Mod - Content Patcher - Random Block
Author: Elthisboy
Description:
[left] [/left] 
[b][img width=416,height=99]https://i.imgur.com/grdUGcd.png[/img]
[/b]
 [b]Lucky Block[/b] is a mod for Stardew Valley inspired by the classic Minecraft Lucky Block mod.This mod adds a new item, the Lucky Block, which can be placed and broken by players.Breaking a Lucky Block triggers a random event that can be beneficial, neutral, or even challenging. 

[img width=247,height=83]https://i.imgur.com/K5Pbycc.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Lucky Blocks:[/b] Place and break Lucky Blocks to discover what surprise awaits you.
[*][b]Random Outcomes:[/b] Over 50 possible outcomes, including rare items, useful resources, unexpected effects, and mini-challenges.
[*][b]Content Patcher Integration:[/b] Easy to install and manage thanks to compatibility with Content Patcher.
[*][b]Random generator:[/b] Appears around the map randomly! Find out where they are every day!
[/list][b][img width=263,height=77]https://i.imgur.com/cqJDLro.png[/img]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Installation:[/b] Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]smapi[/url] and [url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url] installed and place the mod in your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[*][b]Obtaining Lucky Blocks:[/b] You can find Lucky Blocks at Gus's shop, receive them as rewards, or you can crafting!.
[*][b]Break and Discover:[/b] Place the blocks on your farm or anywhere in the valley and break them to discover what surprises await you.
[/list] 
[b]Experience the excitement and risk of Lucky Blocks in Stardew Valley and make every day in the valley a new adventure full of surprises!

[/b]
[b]Note:[/b] This mod does not require Json Assets and is designed to be compatible with other modifications that use Content Patcher.

Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.8 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list][b]Disclaimer:[/b]This is my first mod, and I am continuously working to improve and update it. I appreciate any feedback and suggestions from the community to make this mod better.
